customer_concentration.reconciliation_note: Sum of customer revenues reconciles to total FY2025 revenue within floating-point precision (diff: -8.2e-8 USD). Reconciliation validated in SQL.

arr_bridge.reconciliation_note: ARR bridge reconciles within floating-point precision. Beginning ARR + New Logo + Expansion - Contraction - Churn = Ending ARR. No reactivation events detected in FY2025 monthly sequence.
arr_bridge.new_logo_methodology: A customer is classified as new logo only when they have no prior positive ARR in any snapshot before 2025-01-01. Historical ARR inspected across all 36 monthly snapshots (Jan-2023 to Dec-2025). Zero opening balance alone was not used to establish new-logo status.
arr_bridge.reactivation_methodology: Reactivation = customer with prior positive ARR history who reached zero ARR and returned to positive ARR during FY2025. No such events found in FY2025 monthly sequence.

retention.methodology: Starting cohort: 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01. NRR = ending ARR of starting cohort at 2025-12-01 / starting ARR * 100. GRR = retained ARR (capped at opening ARR per customer, floored at 0) / starting ARR * 100. Logo churn: customers in starting cohort with zero ARR at 2025-12-01. Monthly observations used to confirm no intra-period churn-and-reactivation events (gross churn = net churn = 17). New-logo ARR excluded from NRR/GRR cohort. Reactivation: 0 events in FY2025.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring: sum of all lines where revenue_type='Recurring'. Independently restated recurring: sum of lines where revenue_type='Recurring' AND delivery_model='Subscription' (product_family in Platform and Managed Services). Lines tagged 'Recurring' but with delivery_model='One-time' (Professional Services) are reclassified as non-recurring based on economic substance. No ambiguous lines remain after applying product family and delivery model criteria.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Outstanding-invoice AR basis. Quarter-End AR = sum of invoice_amount_usd for invoices with status='Outstanding' issued in Q4 2025 (all 96 outstanding invoices are dated 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-08). Revenue denominator = sum of fact_invoice_line.line_amount_usd for invoices with invoice_date in Q4 2025. DSO = Quarter-End AR / Q4 Revenue * 92 calendar days. This methodology uses a consistent invoice-period basis for both numerator and denominator. The cumulative-AR approach (all historical invoices minus all historical collections) was tested but produced negative AR balances due to the data structure where collections for some invoices exceed invoice face value — indicating the cumulative approach is not reliable for this dataset. The outstanding-status-based AR is the authoritative receivable balance supported by the data.
collections_quality.dso_data_quality_note: The cumulative AR reconstruction approach (invoices issued on or before quarter-end minus collections received on or before quarter-end) produced negative AR balances for all quarters prior to Q4 2025. Investigation confirmed that fact_collection.amount_paid_usd for some invoices exceeds fact_invoice.invoice_amount_usd (e.g., INV-000157: invoiced $1,190,000, collected $3,570,000). This indicates the cumulative approach is not a reliable DSO methodology for this dataset. The outstanding-invoice-status approach is used as the primary DSO methodology. Historical quarterly DSO using the outstanding-status approach shows zero AR for Q1-Q3 2025 and all of 2023-2024 because no invoices from those periods remain outstanding at the measurement date — consistent with all prior-period invoices being fully settled.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated Top-1 customer concentration is 27.44% (Northwind Retail Group: $11,723,657 of $42,730,073 FY2025 revenue). This materially exceeds the claimed threshold of 10%. Top-2 customer (Vantage Grocers) also exceeds 10% at 12.31%. Final claim verdict belongs to the Claims Adjudicator.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated NRR is 100.52% using the 180-customer opening cohort at 2024-12-01 and closing at 2025-12-01. Starting ARR: $36,075,091; Ending cohort ARR: $36,261,693. This is materially below the claimed 118%. Final claim verdict belongs to the Claims Adjudicator.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: 94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
claim_comparisons.note: Management-tagged recurring revenue is 98.34% ($42,019,536 / $42,730,073). However, independent restatement identifies $4,675,078 tagged as 'Recurring' but associated with Professional Services product family and One-time delivery model. Reclassifying this as non-recurring yields independently restated recurring revenue of 87.40% ($37,344,458 / $42,730,073). The calculated_value represents the independently restated metric. Management-tagged pct (98.34%) is preserved separately. Final claim verdict belongs to the Claims Adjudicator.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated logo churn is 9.44% (17 churned logos out of 180 starting-cohort customers). Monthly observations confirm gross churn = net churn = 17 (no intra-period reactivations). This exceeds the claimed threshold of 5%. Final claim verdict belongs to the Claims Adjudicator.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M represents a 32% margin.
claim_comparisons.note: EBITDA adjustment analysis is outside the Revenue Quality workstream scope. This claim belongs to the EBITDA/Earnings Quality specialist agent. Revenue Quality Agent does not calculate or challenge EBITDA adjustments.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated DSO for Q4 2025 is 59.41 days using outstanding-invoice AR ($6,236,837) divided by Q4 2025 invoice-line revenue ($9,658,745) times 92 days. The claim of 'stable at approximately 45 days' cannot be assessed for stability from a single comparable quarter (prior quarters show zero outstanding AR at measurement date). Weighted collection days for paid invoices shows an increasing trend from 38.89 days (2023-Q1) to a peak of 76.07 days (2025-Q2), declining to 52.22 days in 2025-Q4. The calculated DSO of 59.41 days exceeds the claimed 45 days. Final claim verdict belongs to the Claims Adjudicator.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.
claim_comparisons.note: FY2028 is a forward projection beyond the available structured data (data covers FY2023-FY2025). Current EMEA ARR cannot be isolated from available data as fact_subscription_month does not contain geographic fields. This claim requires document analysis and forward projection outside the Revenue Quality structured-data scope.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: All customer contracts are freely assignable on a change of control.
claim_comparisons.note: Change-of-control clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured field for CoC restrictions. This claim belongs to the Contract Intelligence agent.

claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated CAGR from FY2023 ($34,471,836) to FY2025 ($42,730,073) over 2 periods is 11.34%. metric_evidence.metric: Revenue by fiscal year (FY2023, FY2024, FY2025)
metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) IN (2023, 2024, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Sum of fact_invoice_line.line_amount_usd grouped by fiscal year derived from fact_invoice.invoice_date. Invoice lines joined to invoice headers on invoice_id. No double-counting: each line contributes once. Invoice header amounts reconcile 1:1 to line totals for all 3167 invoices.

metric_evidence.query: WITH yearly AS (SELECT YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) IN (2023, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE))), fy2023 AS (SELECT total_revenue_usd FROM yearly WHERE fiscal_year = 2023), fy2025 AS (SELECT total_revenue_usd FROM yearly WHERE fiscal_year = 2025) SELECT fy2023.total_revenue_usd AS fy2023_revenue, fy2025.total_revenue_usd AS fy2025_revenue, 2 AS num_periods, (POWER(fy2025.total_revenue_usd / fy2023.total_revenue_usd, 1.0/2.0) - 1) * 100 AS cagr_pct FROM fy2023, fy2025
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR = (FY2025 Revenue / FY2023 Revenue)^(1/2) - 1. Calculated entirely in SQL using POWER function. 2 periods (FY2023 to FY2025).

metric_evidence.metric: Customer concentration FY2025 — Top 1, Top 3, Top 5, Top 10
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue_usd) AS total_rev FROM fy2025_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue_usd DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank = 1 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top1_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top3_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 5 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top5_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 10 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top10_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank = 1 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 5 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 10 THEN r.customer_revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r, total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
metric_evidence.methodology: Customer revenue aggregated from invoice lines for FY2025. ROW_NUMBER window function used for ranking. Cumulative Top-N cohorts calculated in SQL. Reconciliation validated: sum of customer revenues = total FY2025 revenue (diff: -8.2e-8 USD, floating-point precision only).

metric_evidence.metric: ARR Bridge FY2025 — Beginning ARR, New Logo, Expansion, Contraction, Churn, Reactivation, Ending ARR
metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month), customer_history AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month < '2025-01-01' AND arr_usd > 0), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, m.prev_arr_usd, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr_usd IS NULL OR m.prev_arr_usd = 0) AND ch.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'new_logo' WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr_usd IS NULL OR m.prev_arr_usd = 0) AND ch.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'reactivation' WHEN m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr_usd AND m.prev_arr_usd > 0 THEN 'expansion' WHEN m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr_usd AND m.arr_usd > 0 THEN 'contraction' WHEN m.arr_usd = 0 AND m.prev_arr_usd > 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'no_change' END AS movement_type, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr_usd IS NULL OR m.prev_arr_usd = 0) THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr_usd AND m.prev_arr_usd > 0 THEN m.arr_usd - m.prev_arr_usd WHEN m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr_usd AND m.arr_usd > 0 THEN m.prev_arr_usd - m.arr_usd WHEN m.arr_usd = 0 AND m.prev_arr_usd > 0 THEN m.prev_arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS movement_amount FROM monthly_arr m LEFT JOIN customer_history ch ON m.customer_id = ch.customer_id WHERE m.snapshot_month >= '2025-01-01' AND m.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01') SELECT movement_type, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(movement_amount) AS total_movement_usd FROM movements WHERE movement_type != 'no_change' GROUP BY movement_type
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR movements derived using LAG window function on fact_subscription_month ordered by snapshot_month per customer. New logo distinguished from reactivation by checking pre-2025 positive ARR history. Bridge reconciliation validated in SQL: Beginning ARR + New Logo + Expansion - Contraction - Churn = Ending ARR (diff: -7.45e-9, floating-point precision).

metric_evidence.query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01'), cohort_with_closing AS (SELECT oc.customer_id, oc.opening_arr, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0) AS closing_arr, LEAST(oc.opening_arr, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0)) AS retained_arr_grr FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(closing_arr) AS ending_arr_cohort, SUM(retained_arr_grr) AS retained_arr_grr, SUM(closing_arr) / SUM(opening_arr) * 100 AS nrr_pct, SUM(retained_arr_grr) / SUM(opening_arr) * 100 AS grr_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_arr = 0 THEN 1 END) AS churned_logos, COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_arr = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS logo_churn_pct FROM cohort_with_closing
metric_evidence.methodology: Opening cohort: customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01 (180 customers). NRR: ending ARR of cohort at 2025-12-01 / opening ARR. GRR: retained ARR (LEAST of opening and closing per customer) / opening ARR. Logo churn: cohort customers with zero closing ARR / total cohort. Monthly observations confirmed no intra-period reactivations (gross = net churn = 17).

metric_evidence.metric: Recurring revenue analysis FY2025 — management-tagged vs independently restated
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_lines AS (SELECT fil.line_amount_usd, fil.revenue_type, fil.service_period_start, fil.service_period_end, dp.product_family, dp.delivery_model FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025) SELECT SUM(line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_tagged_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS mgmt_tagged_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' AND delivery_model = 'Subscription' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' AND delivery_model = 'Subscription' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS restated_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' AND delivery_model = 'One-time' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS reclassified_to_nonrecurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'One-time' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_tagged_onetime FROM fy2025_lines
metric_evidence.methodology: Management-tagged recurring: revenue_type='Recurring'. Independently restated recurring: revenue_type='Recurring' AND delivery_model='Subscription'. Reclassified: revenue_type='Recurring' AND delivery_model='One-time' (Professional Services with one-time delivery — economically non-recurring). All calculations in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: WITH outstanding_ar AS (SELECT fi.invoice_id, fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_date, fi.invoice_amount_usd, fc.days_outstanding, fc.status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE fc.status = 'Outstanding'), total_outstanding AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS total_ar, COUNT(*) AS unpaid_count, MIN(CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_outstanding, MAX(CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS latest_outstanding, AVG(days_outstanding) AS avg_days_outstanding FROM outstanding_ar), q4_2025_rev AS (SELECT SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS q4_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) >= '2025-10-01' AND CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) <= '2025-12-31') SELECT t.total_ar AS outstanding_ar_usd, t.unpaid_count, t.earliest_outstanding, t.latest_outstanding, t.avg_days_outstanding, r.q4_revenue, 92 AS q4_days, t.total_ar / r.q4_revenue * 92 AS dso_q4_2025 FROM total_outstanding t, q4_2025_rev r
metric_evidence.methodology: Outstanding AR = sum of invoice_amount_usd for invoices with fact_collection.status='Outstanding'. All 96 outstanding invoices are dated Q4 2025. DSO = Outstanding AR / Q4 2025 invoice-line revenue * 92 days. Consistent invoice-period basis for numerator and denominator.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT CASE WHEN fc.days_outstanding <= 30 THEN '0-30 days' WHEN fc.days_outstanding <= 60 THEN '31-60 days' WHEN fc.days_outstanding <= 90 THEN '61-90 days' ELSE '90+ days' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS ar_amount_usd, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) / SUM(SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd)) OVER () * 100 AS pct_of_total_ar FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fc.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE fc.status = 'Outstanding' GROUP BY aging_bucket ORDER BY aging_bucket
metric_evidence.methodology: AR aging buckets derived from fact_collection.days_outstanding for Outstanding invoices. Percentage calculated using window function over total outstanding AR.

metric_evidence.metric: Weighted collection days overall and by quarter
metric_evidence.query: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-03-31' THEN '2023-Q1' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-06-30' THEN '2023-Q2' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-07-01' AND '2023-09-30' THEN '2023-Q3' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-12-31' THEN '2023-Q4' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' THEN '2024-Q1' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN '2024-Q2' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN '2024-Q3' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-Q4' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN '2025-Q1' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-Q2' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' THEN '2025-Q3' WHEN CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN '2025-Q4' END AS qtr_label, COUNT(*) AS paid_invoices, AVG(fc.days_outstanding) AS avg_days_outstanding, SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd * fc.days_outstanding) / SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd) AS weighted_collection_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE fc.status = 'Paid' AND fc.amount_paid_usd > 0 GROUP BY qtr_label ORDER BY qtr_label
metric_evidence.methodology: Weighted collection days = sum(amount_paid_usd * days_outstanding) / sum(amount_paid_usd) for Paid invoices. Grouped by invoice quarter. This is a secondary payment-timing metric, not equivalent to period-end DSO.

metric_evidence.query: WITH q4_outstanding AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS customer_ar_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE fc.status = 'Outstanding' AND CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), q4_revenue AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_q4_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), customer_dso AS (SELECT dc.segment, dc.customer_id, COALESCE(oa.customer_ar_usd, 0) AS ar_usd, qr.customer_q4_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc JOIN q4_revenue qr ON dc.customer_id = qr.customer_id LEFT JOIN q4_outstanding oa ON dc.customer_id = oa.customer_id) SELECT segment, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(ar_usd) AS segment_ar, SUM(customer_q4_revenue) AS segment_revenue, SUM(ar_usd) / SUM(customer_q4_revenue) * 92 AS segment_dso FROM customer_dso GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment
metric_evidence.methodology: Segment DSO = segment outstanding AR / segment Q4 2025 invoice-line revenue * 92 days. Consistent with company-level DSO methodology.

metric_evidence.metric: Top-customer DSO cohorts Q4 2025 (Top 1, Top 3, Top 5, Remaining)
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue_usd DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev), q4_outstanding AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS customer_ar_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE fc.status = 'Outstanding' AND CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), q4_revenue AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_q4_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), combined AS (SELECT r.customer_id, r.rev_rank, CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN 'Top 3' ELSE 'Remaining' END AS cohort, COALESCE(oa.customer_ar_usd, 0) AS ar_usd, COALESCE(qr.customer_q4_revenue, 0) AS q4_revenue FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN q4_outstanding oa ON r.customer_id = oa.customer_id LEFT JOIN q4_revenue qr ON r.customer_id = qr.customer_id) SELECT cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(ar_usd) AS cohort_ar_usd, SUM(q4_revenue) AS cohort_q4_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(q4_revenue) > 0 THEN SUM(ar_usd) / SUM(q4_revenue) * 92 ELSE NULL END AS cohort_dso FROM combined GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort
metric_evidence.methodology: Customers ranked by FY2025 full-year invoice-line revenue. Top-N cohorts are cumulative. DSO = cohort outstanding AR / cohort Q4 2025 invoice-line revenue * 92 days. Same methodology as company-level DSO.

metric_evidence.metric: AR concentration reconciliation — Top 3 + Remaining = Total AR
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue_usd DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev), q4_outstanding AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) AS customer_ar_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE fc.status = 'Outstanding' GROUP BY fi.customer_id), combined AS (SELECT r.customer_id, r.rev_rank, COALESCE(oa.customer_ar_usd, 0) AS ar_usd FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN q4_outstanding oa ON r.customer_id = oa.customer_id) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rev_rank <= 3 THEN ar_usd ELSE 0 END) AS top3_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN rev_rank > 3 THEN ar_usd ELSE 0 END) AS remaining_ar, SUM(ar_usd) AS total_ar_from_cohorts FROM combined
metric_evidence.methodology: Validates that Top-3 AR + Remaining AR = Total Outstanding AR. Reconciliation diff: -9.3e-10 (floating-point precision). Cohorts validated as non-overlapping and exhaustive.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer tenure — Top 10 by FY2025 revenue
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue_usd DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev), top10 AS (SELECT r.customer_id, r.customer_revenue_usd, r.rev_rank, dc.customer_name, dc.first_order_date FROM ranked r JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON r.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE r.rev_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, AVG(DATEDIFF(CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS avg_tenure_years, MIN(DATEDIFF(CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS min_tenure_years, MAX(DATEDIFF(CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE), CAST(first_order_date AS DATE)) / 365.25) AS max_tenure_years FROM top10
metric_evidence.methodology: Tenure = DATEDIFF(2025-12-31, first_order_date) / 365.25 for each top-10 customer. Average calculated in SQL. Reference date 2025-12-31 used as fiscal year-end.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer health — top 5 customers by year
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(fi.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), top5 AS (SELECT customer_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue_usd DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev QUALIFY rev_rank <= 5) SELECT t.customer_id, YEAR(CAST(st.opened_date AS DATE)) AS ticket_year, COUNT(*) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN st.severity IN ('Critical','High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_severity_tickets, AVG(CAST(st.csat_score AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_csat FROM top5 t JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket st ON t.customer_id = st.customer_id GROUP BY t.customer_id, YEAR(CAST(st.opened_date AS DATE)) ORDER BY t.customer_id, ticket_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 5 customers dynamically selected from FY2025 revenue ranking. Support metrics aggregated by calendar year. CSAT averaged per customer per year. High-severity defined as severity IN ('Critical','High').

metric_evidence.metric: Contract expiration distribution (reference only — renewal exposure unsupported without authoritative close date)
metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(CAST(contract_end_date AS DATE)) AS expiry_year, COUNT(*) AS contract_count, SUM(acv_usd) AS total_acv_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(contract_end_date AS DATE)) ORDER BY expiry_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Active contracts grouped by expiry year. Provided as reference distribution only. Renewal exposure calculation requires an authoritative deal close date and diligence horizon not available in runtime inputs or test plan.

issues.description: fact_collection.amount_paid_usd exceeds fact_invoice.invoice_amount_usd for multiple invoices (e.g., INV-000157: invoiced $1,190,000, collected $3,570,000). This makes the cumulative AR reconstruction approach (all historical invoices minus all historical collections) unreliable, producing large negative AR balances for all quarters prior to Q4 2025. The outstanding-invoice-status approach is used as the primary DSO methodology instead.
issues.resolution: DSO calculated using outstanding-invoice-status methodology for Q4 2025 only. Historical quarterly DSO trend cannot be reliably constructed.

issues.description: Top-10 customer rank-7 (CUST-0006, Cascade Foods Holdings) has first_order_date of 2025-03-01, yielding tenure of only 0.84 years. This may reflect a new entity, a data entry issue, or a parent-child relationship not captured in the hierarchy. It materially depresses the average top-10 tenure from approximately 6.13 years (excluding this customer) to 5.60 years (including).
issues.resolution: Both values reported. Downstream agents should verify this customer's commercial history.

issues.description: CUST-0002 (Vantage Grocers, revenue rank 2, 12.31% of FY2025 revenue) shows a 245% increase in support ticket volume (20 in 2023 to 69 in 2025) and a sharp CSAT decline from 4.05 to 2.39. This is a quantitative health deterioration signal for the second-largest customer.
issues.resolution: Reported in customer health section. Downstream Contract Intelligence and Reconciliation agents should assess contractual implications.

issues.description: Only 1 of 214 customers has a distinct parent_customer_id, making economic group rollup effectively identical to customer-level analysis. Parent hierarchy is not a material factor for this dataset.
issues.resolution: Customer-level used as primary concentration metric. Economic group level produces identical results.
